verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an operating system, especially for its AI features, but the evidence pack never documents any retention settings or deletion controls for user or Siri AI data. The closest items are a generic claim about built-in protection tools and private browsing, and recovering a deleted password; both are adjacent features, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
